LESSON: PRESSURE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.2: Pressure

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Pressure
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the applications of pressure in solids and liquids?

1. demonstrate pressure in solids and liquids
2. identify applications of pressure in solids and liquids
3. appreciate the applications of pressure in solids and liquids

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

Teach

• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

• Fact 1 about Pressure (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Pressure.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Pressure.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Pressure.
• Say one safety rule.

• demonstrate pressure in solids and liquids
• identify applications of pressure in solids and liquids
• appreciate the applications of pressure in solids and liquids

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Pressure.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Pressure: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the applications of pressure in solids and liquids?
